terms.label: Downfall Timeline
terms.definition: The branch in which the Hero of Time is defeated.
terms.notes: How the branch label is usually treated, in the wording of 01-literature-review.md, section 1, which cites both works for the three-branch model.

terms.label: Child Timeline
terms.definition: The branch in which Link returns and warns Zelda.
terms.notes: How the branch label is usually treated, in the wording of 01-literature-review.md, section 1, which cites both works for the three-branch model.

terms.label: Adult Timeline
terms.definition: The branch left behind after Link disappears from that era.
terms.notes: How the branch label is usually treated, in the wording of 01-literature-review.md, section 1, which cites both works for the three-branch model.

terms.label: timeline split
terms.definition: The three-way division of the chronology after Ocarina of Time into the Downfall, Child and Adult branches.
